steps.text: set ROMM_TEST_DB_TAG to a tag unique to the worktree before running pytest
select the tests affected by the change; never run the whole suite locally
leave the shared romm_test alone: never stamp or downgrade it

pitfalls: a worktree on another branch migrated the shared romm_test to a revision the current branch lacked, and every test errored in setup with "Can't locate revision" (503c9b290)
binding: none: this session owns no active work order

chose: coherence.config.json runs pytest oracles with ROMM_TEST_DB_TAG defaulting to coherence_$$ (one temporary database per run)
over: a fixed coherence tag shared by every worktree
because: a fixed tag would collide between worktrees running oracles at once; the migrated template makes a per-run database cheap and conftest drops it at session end
